Implemented the 10-move motion vocabulary from the 2026-10-02 Gemini handoff (151 unit assertions, mutation-checked against 6 seeded faults). Worked reliably on a long multi-file change, but two operational lessons: (1) the editor insert_line tool silently truncated/scrambled files twice, producing parse errors far from the edit - always re-read and brace-balance-check after an insert_line; (2) subagents and long-running gates fail under the 30s shell timeout, so run gates in detached Start-Process and poll the output file.

Second session: implemented the Canvas2D per-mode effect budget from the 2026-10-02 diagnosis doc (54 assertions, 5 seeded mutations all caught). Verified every claim in the handoff against the source before changing anything - it was accurate to the line. Two editor insert_line failures again (a stray import block, a comment block that lost its // prefixes); both surfaced as parse errors far from the edit, and both were caught by eslint/tsc rather than by reading. Practical lesson: after any multi-part structural edit to a large file, re-read the touched region AND run tsc before moving on.

Follow-up: browser automation found a real dead-UI bug that reading the code had missed - aurora was implemented, budgeted and unit-tested but absent from the hardcoded picker, reachable only via the test harness. Root cause was four divergent copies of the mode list; collapsed to one. Also found an option with value stereo-split-bands that is not a mode. Lessons: (1) hardcoded <option> lists drift from typed source-of-truth arrays - render from the array; (2) when writing a Playwright guard that parses served source, do not anchor the regex on TS-only syntax - Vite strips `as const`, so the match returns empty and the test passes vacuously; I hit exactly this and caught it only by mutation-testing the guard; (3) mutation-testing your own new test is the only way to know it can fail.

Screenshot-driven UX audit session: drove the live frontend via the browser-automation skill (session mode), captured 15 shots across /visualizer, /audio-analysis, /three-js-studio, and found two live bugs reading-only had missed - stem separation 500s on opts.source_path (dataclass lacks the field; tests monkeypatch the broken function) and ShaderVisualizer fetches analysis by cleanTrackName so hash-prefixed files 404. Web research (Exa MCP hit its free rate limit on 1 of 3 searches; websearch tool still worked, suggesting alternates) synthesized into 3 knowledge-library articles + docs/plans/studio-quality-2026-10.md; validator and docs gate pass. Operational: browser.mjs --script fails loudly on a missing file and ui.click times out on hidden (but snapshotted) elements - wrap clicks in try/catch and re-snapshot after state changes; headless default viewport is tiny (780x410), setViewportSize explicitly for layout findings.

Test-suite audit: full Playwright run found 3 failures, all from ONE environmental cause - the Vite devtools overlay intercepting pointer events and fetching icons from an external CDN (whose CORS errors then failed console assertions). Also found __VIZ_TEST__ shipping unguarded in the production bundle; gated with import.meta.env.DEV and verified absent from dist. Lessons: (1) when a Playwright click times out on an element it reports as stable, suspect an overlay - check document.elementFromPoint; (2) always run the FULL suite, not just the specs you touched - the 3 failures were in files I had never edited; (3) assert count > 0, never >= 0; (4) page.evaluate bodies are plain JS, so TS generics inside them are a runtime error tsc will not catch.

Executed Phase 0 of docs/plans/studio-quality-2026-10.md. Fixed a P0 that made stem separation fail on every run: _separate_demucs read opts.source_path, a field SeparationOptions never defined, swallowed by a broad except into result.error; the hierarchical caller also passed a kwarg the signature rejected. Verified BOTH defects by executing the real functions first, per the plan guiding rule. 6 new tests, each mutation-checked (reverting the fix fails 3). Live-verified: separate-file returns 200 with 4 stems on disk. Phase 0.2: display name was being used as an API cache key, 404ing every hash-prefixed upload. Lessons: (1) a dataclass read that is not a field is invisible until you execute the path - grep found it, but proving it took 5 minutes; (2) PowerShell 5.1 has no -Form for Invoke-WebRequest, use Python for multipart; (3) ruff catches import order the pytest run does not.

Completed plan Phase 1 item 1.4 (Cosmic Dust frame wash). Root cause was two shader bugs in instancedParticles.tsx, isolated by an atomic in-page 2x2 causal probe (rotation x scale, write+render+readPixels in one JS task to beat the per-frame lerp): (1) billboard offsets built from world-space camera axes then multiplied through modelViewMatrix, so the LrcViz wrapper's continuous rotation.y sheared the quads - brightness was purely f(ry mod 2pi): face-on wash 0.71+ at ry~0, invisible slivers 0.03 at ry~pi, which is why wash bands kept appearing at different musical positions in different runs (falsified: position-determinism, bass correlation, distance-clump, DOM overlay); (2) baseSize prop never destructured - all styles rendered hardcoded 0.4-1.4 world-unit dust instead of the 0.08-0.1 callers pass (~10x area). Fixed with view-space billboard (mvPosition.xy += offset), honored baseSize (added to deps), added uAlpha uniform. Verified: rotation-invariant means (0.202/0.196/0.200), scene mean 0.20-0.34 video-luma / 0.14-0.19 rel-lum, frac>0.92=0, lyric contrast 10.4-17.3, all 3 particle styles re-captured clean, gates+e2e green. Lessons: (1) a wrong oracle early (scene background hex #000510, only set by preset auto-apply) aborts probes while the style is actually fine - verify via .active button title instead; (2) backend flapped constantly from a concurrent agent restarting it - gate probe runs on two consecutive health+files+audio-file checks 8s apart, and the audio-file URL needs the CURLY apostrophe (U+2019), a straight one 404s forever; (3) atomic multi-variant measurement inside one page.evaluate defeats the useFrame lerp that would otherwise restore state between set and read; (4) fixed tools/vision/analyze.mjs missing baseName import (ReferenceError at resolveModel); vision MCP compare still flaky (timeouts/empty), gemma4 describe worked. PowerShell > writes UTF-16 - read redirected logs with encoding=utf-16.

Web-sourced audit found barkFreqMap inverting Bark with the ERB formula (~3.4x too low; top bar sampled ~1.2kHz not Nyquist). Fixed via barkToHz (Traunmuller). Old range+monotonicity tests could not see it; added round-trip + Nyquist-span + Bark-uniformity tests, mutation-verified. Also caught: my first attempt asserted bass-octave>treble-octave bars, which is false for Bark by construction - Bark is uniform in Bark units, Hz spread widens. Rewrote. Two self-inflicted process errors: rindex cut a closing brace, and a tight 1-bin tolerance failed on Traunmuller approximation, not the bug.

Filesystem MCP investigation: root-caused search_files timeouts on this repo - excludePatterns must match the directory itself (**/node_modules prunes the walk; **/node_modules/** still walks the whole tree and only filters results, which is why earlier attempts timed out). Corrected the record: the filesystem MCP is the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem npm package (v2026.8.31) declared in the GLOBAL ~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc, not a Kilo built-in and not in the project config. Raised its timeout 15s->60s as margin; exclusions are the real fix. Documented the full exclusion recipe in AGENTS.md + machine memory. Verified: full **/*.ts search returns thousands of hits in seconds with exclusions. Lesson: read the server's dist/lib.js (searchFilesWithValidation) before theorizing about pattern semantics - the exclusion check runs before recursion.
